[TritonToUnstructure](fix) Preserve selected pointers across loops (#2284)

Treat arith.select pointer results like scf.if pointer results when
choosing the representation of a loop boundary. Carry complete addresses
consistently through for and while loops instead of mixing i64 offsets
with pointer backedges. Add IR and device numerical regressions.

Signed-off-by: yangkaixin <yangkaixin1@huawei.com>

@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+// RUN: triton-opt %s --triton-to-unstructure -verify-each | FileCheck %s
+
+// Different pointer bases selected inside a loop must travel together as a
+// complete address, including the initial value and the backedge.
+tt.func public @for_select_backedge(%initial: !tt.ptr<i32>,
+    %alternate: !tt.ptr<i32>, %count: index) -> i32 {
+  %c0 = arith.constant 0 : index
+  %c1 = arith.constant 1 : index
+  %result = scf.for %i = %c0 to %count step %c1
+      iter_args(%ptr = %initial) -> (!tt.ptr<i32>) {
+    %condition = arith.cmpi eq, %i, %c0 : index
+    %next = arith.select %condition, %alternate, %ptr : !tt.ptr<i32>
+    scf.yield %next : !tt.ptr<i32>
+  }
+  %loaded = tt.load %result : !tt.ptr<i32>
+  tt.return %loaded : i32
+}
+
+// CHECK-LABEL: tt.func public @for_select_backedge
+// CHECK:       tt.ptr_to_int
+// CHECK:       scf.for
+// CHECK-SAME:  -> (i64)
+// CHECK:       tt.int_to_ptr
+// CHECK:       arith.select {{.*}} : !tt.ptr<i32>
+// CHECK:       tt.ptr_to_int
+// CHECK:       scf.yield {{.*}} : i64
+
+tt.func public @while_select_backedge(%initial: !tt.ptr<i32>,
+    %alternate: !tt.ptr<i32>, %count: i32) -> i32 {
+  %c0 = arith.constant 0 : i32
+  %c1 = arith.constant 1 : i32
+  %result:2 = scf.while (%i = %c0, %ptr = %initial)
+      : (i32, !tt.ptr<i32>) -> (i32, !tt.ptr<i32>) {
+    %continue = arith.cmpi slt, %i, %count : i32
+    scf.condition(%continue) %i, %ptr : i32, !tt.ptr<i32>
+  } do {
+  ^bb0(%i: i32, %ptr: !tt.ptr<i32>):
+    %next_i = arith.addi %i, %c1 : i32
+    %condition = arith.cmpi eq, %i, %c0 : i32
+    %next = arith.select %condition, %alternate, %ptr : !tt.ptr<i32>
+    scf.yield %next_i, %next : i32, !tt.ptr<i32>
+  }
+  %loaded = tt.load %result#1 : !tt.ptr<i32>
+  tt.return %loaded : i32
+}
+
+// CHECK-LABEL: tt.func public @while_select_backedge
+// CHECK:       scf.while
+// CHECK-SAME:  (i32, i64) -> (i32, i64)
+// CHECK:       scf.condition
+// CHECK-SAME:  i32, i64
+// CHECK:       arith.select {{.*}} : !tt.ptr<i32>
+// CHECK:       tt.ptr_to_int
+// CHECK:       scf.yield {{.*}} : i32, i64

@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+import pytest
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _pointer_select_loop(X, Y, Out, N, USE_WHILE: tl.constexpr):
+    pointer = X
+    total = tl.full((), 0, tl.int32)
+    if USE_WHILE:
+        i = 0
+        while i < N:
+            pointer = tl.where(i % 2 == 0, pointer + 1, Y + i)
+            total += tl.load(pointer)
+            i += 1
+    else:
+        for i in range(N):
+            pointer = tl.where(i % 2 == 0, pointer + 1, Y + i)
+            total += tl.load(pointer)
+    tl.store(Out, total)
+    tl.store(Out + 1, tl.load(pointer))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("use_while", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("count", [0, 1, 5])
+def test_scalar_pointer_select_loop(use_while, count):
+    x = torch.arange(10, 18, device="npu", dtype=torch.int32)
+    y = torch.arange(100, 108, device="npu", dtype=torch.int32)
+    output = torch.empty(2, device="npu", dtype=torch.int32)
+    _pointer_select_loop[(1, )](x, y, output, count, use_while)
+    base, offset, total = 10, 0, 0
+    for i in range(count):
+        if i % 2 == 0:
+            offset += 1
+        else:
+            base, offset = 100, i
+        total += base + offset
+    expected = torch.tensor([total, base + offset], dtype=torch.int32)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(output.cpu(), expected, rtol=0, atol=0)

+def _is_a3_target(_semantic) -> bool:
+    # A2 and A3 share the memory-vector libdevice ABI.
+    arch = _semantic.builder.options.arch
+    return isinstance(arch, str) and arch.startswith(("Ascend910B", "Ascend910_93"))
+
+
+# A2/A3 CCE workspace ABI tuples contain:
+# (row count, storage dtype, operation-sized rows).
+# Sizes are element counts. Fixed rows contain 64 lanes; operation-sized
+# rows are rounded to 8 elements to keep 32-bit row starts 32-byte aligned.
+def _libdevice_elementwise(lib_name, lib_path, args, arg_type_symbol_dict, is_pure, workspace, _semantic=None):
+    if _is_a3_target(_semantic):
+        return _extern_elementwise(lib_name, lib_path, args, arg_type_symbol_dict, is_pure, workspace, _semantic)
+    return core.extern_elementwise(lib_name, lib_path, args, arg_type_symbol_dict, is_pure=is_pure, _semantic=_semantic)
+
+
+def _extern_elementwise(lib_name, lib_path, args, arg_type_symbol_dict, is_pure, workspace, _semantic=None):
+    args = [_semantic.to_tensor(arg) for arg in args]
+    result = core.extern_elementwise(lib_name, lib_path, args, arg_type_symbol_dict, is_pure=is_pure,
+                                     _semantic=_semantic)
+
+    rows, dtype, operation_sized = workspace
+    extent = 64
+    if operation_sized:
+        # Frontend block shapes are static, and include the broadcasted result.
+        elements = result.type.numel if result.type.is_block() else 1
+        extent = ((elements + 7) // 8) * 8
+    builder = _semantic.builder
+    result.handle.set_attr("extra_buffers_types", builder.get_type_array_attr([dtype.to_ir(builder)]))
+    result.handle.set_attr("extra_buffers_sizes", builder.get_i64_array_attr([rows * extent]))
+    return result

     在Triton算子编程中，mask运算经常运用在load/store/where等语法中，在性能优化过程中，需要特别注意这类运算导致的性能下降。当Triton算子内逻辑是单次顺序执行，开始->数据搬入->计算->数据搬出->结束，指令无法并行，执行效率低;可以通过在算子使用for循环增加tiling，将单次处理量减少，多次处理，能够让"数据搬入/计算/数据搬出"并行起来，减少串行的等待时间，提升整体性能；同时使用for循环增加Tiling，也能降低单次处理消耗的UB空间。
     需要注意：增加数据Tiling也同时需要考虑改变数据切块后的数学是否等价。

+name: Release Docker Images Nightly
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      tag_suffix:
+        description: "附加到标准镜像 tag 后的可选后缀，例如 nightly、B021"
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: nightly
+      push_images:
+        description: "是否登录 registry 并推送镜像；在 fork 中无凭据时可关闭"
+        required: false
+        type: boolean
+        default: true
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: release-docker-nightly-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+env:
+  # 华为云 SWR 镜像仓库。
+  REGISTRY: swr.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com
+  IMAGE_REPOSITORY: swr.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/opentile/triton
+
+  TRITON_ASCEND_VERSION: "3.6.0"
+  CANN_VERSION: "9.2.0"
+  PYTORCH_VERSION: "2.10.0"
+  TORCH_NPU_VERSION: "2.10.0.post7"
+  PYTHON_VERSION: "3.11.15"
+  PYTHON_SERIES: "3.11"
+
+jobs:
+  build:
+    name: Build ${{ matrix.device_type }}-${{ matrix.os.name }}-${{ matrix.platform.arch }}
+    runs-on: ${{ matrix.platform.runner }}
+    timeout-minutes: 360
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+    env:
+      PUSH_IMAGE: ${{ inputs.push_images && 'true' || 'false' }}
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        device_type: ["910b", "950", "a3"]
+        os:
+          - name: debian12
+            base_image: debian:12
+          - name: ubuntu24.04
+            base_image: ubuntu:24.04
+          - name: openeuler24.03
+            base_image: openeuler/openeuler:24.03-lts
+        platform:
+          - arch: amd64
+            runner: ubuntu-24.04
+          - arch: arm64
+            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
+
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout repository
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Free up disk space
+        uses: jlumbroso/free-disk-space@54081f138730dfa15788a46383842cd2f914a1be
+        with:
+          tool-cache: true
+          docker-images: false
+
+      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
+        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
+
+      - name: Log in to Huawei Cloud SWR
+        if: ${{ env.PUSH_IMAGE == 'true' }}
+        uses: huaweicloud/swr-login@v2.1.0
+        with:
+          region: cn-north-4
+          access-key-id: ${{ secrets.HUAWEI_CLOUD_AK }}
+          access-key-secret: ${{ secrets.HUAWEI_CLOUD_SK }}
+
+      - name: Generate image tags
+        id: tags
+        run: |
+          base_tag="${TRITON_ASCEND_VERSION}-cann${CANN_VERSION}-torch_npu${TORCH_NPU_VERSION}-${{ matrix.device_type }}-${{ matrix.os.name }}-py${PYTHON_SERIES}"
+          arch_tag="${base_tag}-${{ matrix.platform.arch }}"
+          echo "base_tag=${base_tag}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
+          echo "arch_tag=${arch_tag}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
+          echo "Architecture image: ${IMAGE_REPOSITORY}:${arch_tag}"
+          echo "Final image:        ${IMAGE_REPOSITORY}:${base_tag}"
+
+      - name: Build and push platform image
+        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
+        with:
+          context: .
+          file: docker/cann9.2.0_npu.Dockerfile
+          platforms: linux/${{ matrix.platform.arch }}
+          load: false
+          no-cache: true
+          outputs: ${{ env.PUSH_IMAGE == 'true' && 'type=registry,oci-mediatypes=false' || '' }}
+          provenance: false
+          sbom: false
+          tags: ${{ env.IMAGE_REPOSITORY }}:${{ steps.tags.outputs.arch_tag }}
+          labels: |
+            org.opencontainers.image.title=Triton-Ascend
+            org.opencontainers.image.description=Triton-Ascend ${{ env.TRITON_ASCEND_VERSION }} for ${{ matrix.device_type }} on ${{ matrix.os.name }} (${{ matrix.platform.arch }})
+            org.opencontainers.image.version=${{ steps.tags.outputs.arch_tag }}
+            org.opencontainers.image.revision=${{ github.sha }}
+            org.opencontainers.image.source=${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}
+          build-args: |
+            BASE_IMAGE=${{ matrix.os.base_image }}
+            DEVICE_TYPE=${{ matrix.device_type }}
+            TRITON_ASCEND_VERSION=${{ env.TRITON_ASCEND_VERSION }}
+            CANN_VERSION=${{ env.CANN_VERSION }}
+            PYTORCH_VERSION=${{ env.PYTORCH_VERSION }}
+            TORCH_NPU_VERSION=${{ env.TORCH_NPU_VERSION }}
+            PYTHON_VERSION=${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
+            PYTHON_SERIES=${{ env.PYTHON_SERIES }}
+
+  merge:
+    name: Merge ${{ matrix.device_type }}-${{ matrix.os.name }}
+    needs: build
+    if: ${{ inputs.push_images }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 30
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+    env:
+      TAG_SUFFIX: ${{ inputs.tag_suffix }}
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false

+        os:
+          - name: debian12
+          - name: ubuntu24.04
+          - name: openeuler24.03
+
+    steps:
+      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
+        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
+
+      - name: Log in to Huawei Cloud SWR
+        uses: huaweicloud/swr-login@v2.1.0
+        with:
+          region: cn-north-4
+          access-key-id: ${{ secrets.HUAWEI_CLOUD_AK }}
+          access-key-secret: ${{ secrets.HUAWEI_CLOUD_SK }}
+
+      - name: Generate image tag
+        id: tags
+        run: |
+          base_tag="${TRITON_ASCEND_VERSION}-cann${CANN_VERSION}-torch_npu${TORCH_NPU_VERSION}-${{ matrix.device_type }}-${{ matrix.os.name }}-py${PYTHON_SERIES}"
+          echo "base_tag=${base_tag}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
+
+      - name: Create multi-arch manifest
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          BASE_TAG: ${{ steps.tags.outputs.base_tag }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+

+ARG BASE_IMAGE=debian:12
+ARG DEVICE_TYPE=910b
+
+ARG CANN_VERSION=9.2.0
+ARG PYTHON_VERSION=3.11.15
+ARG PYTHON_SERIES=3.11
+ARG PYTORCH_VERSION=2.10.0
+ARG TORCH_NPU_VERSION=2.10.0.post7
+ARG TRITON_ASCEND_VERSION=3.6.0
+ARG LLVM_COMMIT=b5cc222d7429fe6f18c787f633d5262fac2e676f
+ARG PIP_SOURCE=https://mirrors.ustc.edu.cn/pypi/simple
+
+
+# Stage 1: Install Python
+FROM ${BASE_IMAGE} AS python-installer
+
+ARG BASE_IMAGE
+ARG PYTHON_VERSION
+ARG PYTHON_SERIES
+
+SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-c"]
+
+ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
+ENV PATH=/usr/local/python${PYTHON_VERSION}/bin:${PATH}
+ENV LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/python${PYTHON_VERSION}/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}
+
+RUN set -eux; \
+    if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
+        if [ -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources ]; then \
+            sed -i 's|deb.debian.org|mirrors.ustc.edu.cn|g' /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources; \
+        fi; \
+        apt-get update; \
+        apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y \
+            apt-transport-https \
+            ca-certificates \
+            bash \
+            curl \
+            build-essential \
+            libssl-dev \
+            zlib1g-dev \
+            libncurses5-dev \
+            libbz2-dev \
+            libreadline-dev \
+            libsqlite3-dev \
+            libffi-dev \
+            libnss3-dev \
+            libgdbm-dev \
+            liblzma-dev \
+            libev-dev; \
+        apt-get clean; \
+        rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* /var/tmp/*; \
+    elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
+        yum -y update; \
+        yum install -y \
+            gcc \
+            gcc-c++ \
+            make \
+            cmake \
+            curl \
+            zlib-devel \
+            bzip2-devel \
+            openssl-devel \
+            ncurses-devel \
+            sqlite-devel \
+            readline-devel \
+            tk-devel \
+            gdbm-devel \
+            libpcap-devel \
+            xz-devel \
+            libev-devel \
+            expat-devel \
+            libffi-devel \
+            systemtap-sdt-devel; \
+        yum clean all; \
+        rm -rf /var/cache/yum /var/cache/dnf; \
+    else \
+        echo "Unsupported package manager in BASE_IMAGE=${BASE_IMAGE}" >&2; \
+        exit 1; \
+    fi; \
+    rm -rf /tmp/*
+
+RUN set -eux; \
+    curl -fsSL \
+        "https://repo.huaweicloud.com/python/${PYTHON_VERSION}/Python-${PYTHON_VERSION}.tgz" \
+        -o /tmp/Python-${PYTHON_VERSION}.tgz; \
+    tar -xf /tmp/Python-${PYTHON_VERSION}.tgz -C /tmp; \
+    cd /tmp/Python-${PYTHON_VERSION}; \
+    mkdir -p /usr/local/python${PYTHON_VERSION}/lib; \
+    ./configure \
+        --enable-shared \
+        --prefix=/usr/local/python${PYTHON_VERSION} \
+        LDFLAGS="-Wl,-rpath /usr/local/python${PYTHON_VERSION}/lib"; \
+    make -j"$(nproc)"; \
+    make altinstall; \
+    ln -sf /usr/local/python${PYTHON_VERSION}/bin/python${PYTHON_SERIES} \
+        /usr/local/python${PYTHON_VERSION}/bin/python3; \
+    ln -sf /usr/local/python${PYTHON_VERSION}/bin/pip${PYTHON_SERIES} \
+        /usr/local/python${PYTHON_VERSION}/bin/pip3; \
+    ln -sf /usr/local/python${PYTHON_VERSION}/bin/python3 \
+        /usr/local/python${PYTHON_VERSION}/bin/python; \
+    ln -sf /usr/local/python${PYTHON_VERSION}/bin/pip3 \
+        /usr/local/python${PYTHON_VERSION}/bin/pip; \
+    rm -rf /tmp/*
+
+
+# Stage 2: install CANN, PyTorch, torch_npu, and Triton-Ascend.
+FROM python-installer AS cann-installer
+
+ARG BASE_IMAGE
+ARG CANN_VERSION
+ARG DEVICE_TYPE
+ARG PYTORCH_VERSION
+ARG TORCH_NPU_VERSION
+ARG TRITON_ASCEND_VERSION
+ARG PIP_SOURCE
+ARG TARGETARCH
+
+RUN set -eux; \
+    if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
+        apt-get update; \
+        apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y \
+            git \
+            wget \
+            gcc \
+            g++ \
+            make \
+            cmake \
+            zlib1g \
+            openssl \
+            unzip \
+            pciutils \
+            net-tools \
+            libblas-dev \
+            gfortran \
+            patchelf \
+            libblas3; \
+        apt-get clean; \
+        rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* /var/tmp/*; \
+    elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
+        unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH PYTHONHOME PYTHONPATH; \
+        yum -y update; \
+        yum install -y \
+            unzip \
+            pciutils \
+            net-tools \
+            lapack-devel \
+            gcc-gfortran \
+            util-linux \
+            findutils \
+            wget; \
+        yum clean all; \
+        rm -rf /var/cache/yum /var/cache/dnf; \
+    else \
+        echo "Unsupported package manager in BASE_IMAGE=${BASE_IMAGE}" >&2; \
+        exit 1; \
+    fi; \
+    rm -rf /tmp/*
+
+RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip --index-url "${PIP_SOURCE}"
+
+RUN set -eux; \
+    case "${TARGETARCH}" in \
+        amd64) ARCH="x86_64" ;; \
+        arm64) ARCH="aarch64" ;; \
+        *) echo "Unsupported TARGETARCH=${TARGETARCH}" >&2; exit 1 ;; \
+    esac; \
+    case "${DEVICE_TYPE}" in \
+        910b) OPS_NAME="910b" ;; \
+        950)  OPS_NAME="950" ;; \
+        a3)   OPS_NAME="A3" ;; \
+        *) echo "Unsupported DEVICE_TYPE=${DEVICE_TYPE}" >&2; exit 1 ;; \
+    esac; \
+    CANN_TOOLKIT_URL="https://ascend-repo.obs.cn-east-2.myhuaweicloud.com/CANN/CANN%20${CANN_VERSION}/Ascend-cann-toolkit_${CANN_VERSION}_linux-${ARCH}.run"; \
+    CANN_OPS_URL="https://ascend-repo.obs.cn-east-2.myhuaweicloud.com/CANN/CANN%20${CANN_VERSION}/Ascend-cann-${OPS_NAME}-ops_${CANN_VERSION}_linux-${ARCH}.run"; \
+    wget --quiet --header="Referer: https://www.hiascend.com/" \
+        "${CANN_TOOLKIT_URL}" -O /root/Ascend-cann-toolkit.run; \
+    wget --quiet --header="Referer: https://www.hiascend.com/" \
+        "${CANN_OPS_URL}" -O /root/Ascend-cann-ops.run; \
+    chmod +x /root/Ascend-cann-toolkit.run /root/Ascend-cann-ops.run; \
+    /root/Ascend-cann-toolkit.run --quiet --install --install-for-all; \
+    /root/Ascend-cann-ops.run --quiet --install --install-for-all; \
+    rm -f /root/Ascend-cann-toolkit.run /root/Ascend-cann-ops.run
+
+RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir \
+        pyyaml \
+        setuptools \
+        pybind11 \
+        ninja \
+        cmake \
+        wheel \
+        tabulate \
+        --index-url "${PIP_SOURCE}"
+
+RUN set -eux; \
+    case "${TARGETARCH}" in \
+        amd64) \
+            pip3 install --no-cache-dir "torch==${PYTORCH_VERSION}+cpu" \
+                --index-url https://mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/pytorch-wheels/whl/cpu/ ;; \
+        arm64) \
+            pip3 install --no-cache-dir "torch==${PYTORCH_VERSION}" \
+                --index-url "${PIP_SOURCE}" ;; \
+        *) \
+            echo "Unsupported TARGETARCH=${TARGETARCH}" >&2; \
+            exit 1 ;; \
+    esac; \
+    pip3 install --no-cache-dir "torch-npu==${TORCH_NPU_VERSION}" \
+        --index-url "${PIP_SOURCE}"; \
+    pip3 install --no-cache-dir "triton-ascend==${TRITON_ASCEND_VERSION}" \
+        --index-url "${PIP_SOURCE}" \
+        --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
+
+
+# Stage 3: build LLVM/MLIR with the same configuration as the original images.
+FROM python-installer AS llvm-installer
+
+ARG BASE_IMAGE
+ARG LLVM_COMMIT
+ARG PIP_SOURCE
+
+RUN set -eux; \
+    if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
+        apt-get update; \
+        apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y \
+            gcc \
+            g++ \
+            make \
+            cmake \
+            zlib1g-dev \
+            libzstd-dev \
+            clang-15 \
+            ccache \
+            lld-15 \
+            git; \
+        apt-get clean; \
+        rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* /var/tmp/*; \
+        ln -sf /usr/bin/clang-15 /usr/bin/clang; \
+        ln -sf /usr/bin/clang++-15 /usr/bin/clang++; \
+    elif command -v yum >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
+        unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH PYTHONHOME PYTHONPATH; \
+        yum -y update; \
+        yum install -y \
+            gcc \
+            g++ \
+            make \
+            cmake \
+            zlib-devel \
+            libzstd \
+            libzstd-devel \
+            ccache \
+            clang \
+            lld \
+            git; \
+        yum clean all; \
+        rm -rf /var/cache/yum /var/cache/dnf; \
+    else \
+        echo "Unsupported package manager in BASE_IMAGE=${BASE_IMAGE}" >&2; \
+        exit 1; \
+    fi; \
+    rm -rf /tmp/*
+
+RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir \
+        ninja \
+        cmake \
+        wheel \
+        pybind11 \
+        --index-url "${PIP_SOURCE}"
+
+RUN set -eux; \
+    git config --global http.postBuffer 524288000; \
+    git config --global http.lowSpeedLimit 0; \
+    git config --global http.lowSpeedTime 1800; \
+    git clone --no-checkout --filter=blob:none https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project.git; \
+    cd llvm-project; \
+    git checkout "${LLVM_COMMIT}"; \
+    mkdir build; \
+    cd build; \
+    C_COMPILER="$(command -v clang-15 || command -v clang)"; \
+    CXX_COMPILER="$(command -v clang++-15 || command -v clang++)"; \
+    LLD_LINKER="$(command -v lld-15 || command -v lld || command -v ld.lld)"; \
+    cmake ../llvm \
+        -G Ninja \
+        -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER="${C_COMPILER}" \
+        -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER="${CXX_COMPILER}" \
+        -DCMAKE_LINKER="${LLD_LINKER}" \
+        -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
+        -DLLVM_ENABLE_ASSERTIONS=ON \
+        -DLLVM_ENABLE_PROJECTS="mlir;llvm;lld" \
+        -DLLVM_TARGETS_TO_BUILD="host;NVPTX;AMDGPU" \
+        -DLLVM_ENABLE_LLD=ON \
+        -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local/llvm-install; \
+    ninja install
